title: How Much Does Seedance 2.5 Pricing Cost in 2026?
summary: Seedance pricing details clarify the monthly credit allocations and feature access included across every subscription tier.
body_markdown:
## Seedance pricing plans and credit limits


### Accessing seedance via jimeng AI


To access the Seedance model and purchase the plans described below, users must navigate to the Jimeng AI platform (known as Chikyu in certain international markets).


Seedance is the technical name for the underlying research model, but ByteDance does not offer a direct sign-up page under the "Seedance" brand for end-users.


The pricing tiers and credit limits listed in this guide refer to the official Jimeng AI web and mobile interfaces.


By subscribing to Jimeng, you gain direct access to the Seedance V2.5 engine, allowing you to leverage its superior price-to-fidelity ratio without searching for a non-existent standalone website.


Integrating these generations into a broader production pipeline, such as a localized social media campaign managed via[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) , ensures that your creative output transitions into distribution without manual file handling.


### The Free Tier: Watermarks and trial limits


When you need to verify the model's adherence to specific prompts before committing to a paid subscription, the Free tier acts as a non-commercial testing ground.


Every video exported under this plan includes a visible watermark, which prevents the content from being used in professional client deliverables or monetized channels.


A **daily credit allocation that doesn't roll over** restricts you. This means any unused generation capacity expires at the end of each twenty-four-hour cycle.


### Seedance Starter plan pricing and features


The Starter plan serves as the first step for creators who have outgrown the daily limits of the free tier but do not yet require full commercial rights.


Priced at approximately ten dollars per month, this tier provides a fixed monthly credit balance that allows for **roughly twenty to thirty standard-definition generations** .


While it removes the daily expiration pressure, it typically maintains the watermark and personal-use-only restrictions found in the trial version.


### Seedance Creator plan pricing and features


Designed for independent influencers, the Creator plan bridges the gap between casual experimentation and professional production at a mid-range price point.


This tier offers a larger credit pool than the Starter plan and often introduces the ability to export without watermarks for non-commercial social sharing.


It remains a personal-use tier, meaning that while your social media presence can look professional, you cannot legally sell the raw assets to third-party clients.


### Seedance Pro plan pricing and features


By removing the watermark and granting a commercial use license, the Pro plan allows you to legally utilize AI-generated footage in advertisements and sponsored content.


Subscribing to this tier increases the maximum export resolution, providing the pixel density required for high-definition displays rather than just mobile previews.


This plan operates on a monthly credit budget that supports significantly more generations than the trial. If you exhaust your balance, you'll have to wait for the next billing cycle or purchase top-up packs to continue working.


### Seedance Studio plan pricing and features


Production houses requiring simultaneous generations and the highest priority in the processing queue should look to the Studio plan.


It has the largest monthly credit pool and supports the longest video durations available on the platform. This reduces the need to stitch multiple clips together for mid-form content.


Because this tier includes multi-user seats, you can manage a shared balance across your team. The shared balance prevents individual account limits from stalling high-volume projects.
